sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 700. Success value 100. 3x physical damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Slumber for 40 seconds with a success value of 120.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces status ailment resistance value by 100 for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Status ailment resistance value boosted by 60 for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 50.
-Target: yourself. Applies Skirmish for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects; [Special] fill your Unison gauge by 3 and recover 5 Cost when using an Ability; [Special] restores CP based on damage dealt. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 40000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Dawn for 150 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; recovers 10 Cost when using an Ability. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; applies Dual Attack; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
